summary: GCP Marketplace provisioning fails with ENTITLEMENT_REGION_MISMATCH when buyer org region differs from purchase region
environment: prod (GCP Marketplace SaaS entitlement -> Redwood Console org linking)
description:
Issue summary
- Customer purchased Redwood Inference via GCP Marketplace and is unable to complete provisioning/org linking in the Redwood Console.
- Console shows a validation error that appears to be a region mismatch between the GCP Marketplace entitlement and the Redwood org “home region”.

Customer impact
- Blocking activation after procurement (cannot use Hosted API under marketplace billing).
- Customer is in procurement stage and needs a working activation path for internal approval.

What the customer sees
- During Console → Settings → Cloud Marketplace → “Link purchase”, they paste the GCP entitlement ID and click “Validate & activate”.
- Error banner: “Provisioning validation failed: ENTITLEMENT_REGION_MISMATCH. Entitlement region us-central1 does not match org region eu-west.”

Environment / context
- Customer Redwood org was created earlier with org region pinned to EU (eu-west).
- GCP Marketplace purchase was completed with billing/data processing location set to us-central1 (default).

Steps to reproduce (internal)
1) Create Redwood org with region = eu-west.
2) Use a GCP Marketplace entitlement where consumer region = us-central1.
3) Attempt to link entitlement to the eu-west org.
4) Provisioning service rejects with ENTITLEMENT_REGION_MISMATCH.

Expected behavior
- Console should clearly explain that GCP Marketplace entitlements are region-scoped and that the buyer must link to a matching region org (or select a region at linking time).
- Ideally, the linking flow should allow choosing the target region/org (or the system should create a matching-region org automatically).

Actual behavior
- Provisioning fails with a generic region mismatch error.
- UI does not provide an actionable remediation path other than “contact support”.

Diagnostics
- Console request ID: rw_req_7c1d1f0b8c
- Backend trace ID: 8f1c0d2a7b9e3d11
- Provisioning service log (sanitized):
  - level=warn msg="entitlement validation failed" error_code=ENTITLEMENT_REGION_MISMATCH entitlement_region="us-central1" org_region="eu-west" entitlement_id="gcpentl-4f7d…" org_id="org_01HT…"

Workaround (customer-facing)
Option A (fastest): Create a new Redwood org in the matching region (US) and link the marketplace entitlement to that org. After activation, set routing/model endpoints as needed.
Option B (if EU region is required for data locality): Customer must re-purchase/re-deploy the GCP Marketplace offering with an EU region/data processing location, then link to their EU org.

Resolution
- Support created a temporary matching-region org for HelioWorks (us-east) and linked the GCP entitlement successfully.
- Customer confirmed the entitlement is active and API calls are being billed via marketplace.

Follow-up
- ENG-4472: Improve Console org-linking UX for GCP Marketplace to prevent region mismatch surprises (region selection, clearer error copy, and docs link).
comments:
2025-02-06 09:14 PT — Dev Patel (Support)
Triage: Reproduced internally with a eu-west org + us-central1 entitlement. Error thrown by provisioning validator: ENTITLEMENT_REGION_MISMATCH.

Next: pulling entitlement payload from audit logs + confirming whether GCP entitlements are region-scoped by design or if we can safely relax validation.

2025-02-06 09:32 PT — Dev Patel (Support) → Customer (HelioWorks)
Thanks — we can see the entitlement is issued for us-central1, but your Redwood org is pinned to eu-west. Today our marketplace activation is region-scoped, so linking will fail if the regions don’t match.

Two paths:
1) Fastest: we can help you activate by linking the entitlement to a US-region org.
2) If EU processing is required: you’ll need to re-deploy/re-purchase in an EU region, then link to your EU org.

Can you confirm whether EU-only is a hard requirement for this initial evaluation?

2025-02-06 10:05 PT — Marcus Lin (Security Engineering)
+1 that we should not silently “cross-region” entitlements without clear buyer intent; could create confusion for residency claims.
If we add an override, it should be explicit + logged, and docs need to call out that marketplace billing region and serving region are distinct concepts (if that’s true for our architecture).

2025-02-06 10:22 PT — Ethan Park (Engineering - Control Plane)
Validator currently enforces entitlement_region == org_region. This was added to avoid accidental linking across regions during early GCP onboarding.

We can improve UX:
- Make region visible earlier in linking flow.
- Allow creating a new org in the entitlement region as part of the wizard.
- Better error string + docs link.

Suggest we keep backend validation for now (safe default). I’ll file an eng task for Console + onboarding flow updates.

2025-02-06 11:01 PT — Dev Patel (Support)
Confirmed with customer: EU-only is preferred long-term, but for procurement they just need to get running this week under marketplace billing.
Proceeding with workaround Option A: create matching-region org (US) and link entitlement there.

2025-02-06 11:26 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend)
If Support creates a new org: remind customer they must be logged into the correct org when they click “Link purchase” (we’ve seen cross-org mistakes). Also, Console currently caches the last failed entitlement ID; user should refresh after switching orgs.

2025-02-06 12:03 PT — Dev Patel (Support)
Created new org for HelioWorks: org_01J2US9C2K3V7A (region=us-east). Sent instructions to customer to switch org and re-run linking.

Internal note: we should add a warning when entitlement region != current org region BEFORE we hit activate.

2025-02-06 13:18 PT — Dev Patel (Support)
Customer confirmed activation succeeded on the US org. They can now generate API keys and successfully call /v1/chat.completions.

Closing as Resolved. Tracking follow-up UX/doc improvements under ENG-4472.

2025-02-06 13:27 PT — Dev Patel (Support)
ENG-4472 created: “GCP Marketplace org linking: show entitlement region + allow region/org selection + actionable error for region mismatch”.
resolution: Workaround provided; entitlement successfully linked to matching-region org. Follow-up engineering task filed for UX/docs improvements.
customer_facing_next_steps: Customer to use the newly created US-region org for marketplace-billed evaluation. If EU-only is required, customer to re-deploy/purchase the Marketplace offering in an EU region and then link to an EU-region Redwood org.
internal_next_steps: ENG-4472 to improve region selection/visibility in Console linking flow and update GCP marketplace onboarding docs; keep backend validation until UX prevents mismatches.
